offence: Alleged breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 18 (Lance Stroll), the driver of Car 77 (Valtteri Bottas), team representatives and reviewed video, timing, team radio and incar video evidence and determined that Car 77 was on a fast lap while approaching Turn 13 when he encountered a series of cars that were bunched up in front. Of those cars, Car 18 was on the racing line and therefore impeded his progress on a fast lap. At the hearing, Bottas said that his lap was already compromised when he approached Turn 13 and this was exacerbated by Car 18 being on the racing line thereafter. However, both he and his team representative said that they did not think that Car 18 was wholly to blame for the fact that he was impeded because of the situation on track at the time. Car 18 attempted to but was prevented from going off the racing line as there was Car 10 on his left, closing in on Car 63 and Car 77 approaching from the right. At about the same time, Car 63 and a series of other cars were being overtaken on the left by Car 4. The result of all of this was that Car 18 had to remain on the racing line and Car 77 had to abort his lap. While it was clear that Car 77 was impeded, Article 37.5 required that the car not be "unnecessarily" impeded by another car. Here, given the situation on track and the fact that the driver and the team representative of Car 77 did not feel that there was a single other competitor that unnecessarily impeded, we decided that there would be no further action.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
team: Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team
title: Decision Car 18 Impeding Of Car 77
